simple.meaning: a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֹזֶה (H2374) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 21 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֹזֶה (chôzeh) means a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 21 9.
